assumptions.artist_reversal_rule: every configured artist's usable-pair point estimate must be positive for each endpoint in every draw; one scenario forces artist 0's true effect negative while preserving the equally weighted grand scenario effect; support in that stress is false support, so lower is better and it is excluded from positive-effect sensitivity rankings
assumptions.availability_estimand: probability of a usable response, reported separately from conditional A-vector proximity; refusals are outcomes and are not imputed
assumptions.availability_floor_boundary: the simulator evaluates raw aggregate and per-artist complete-pair fractions plus a raw max-minus-min artist disparity; no crossed-cluster availability confidence lower bound is implemented, so these diagnostics cannot satisfy the protocol's future availability gate
assumptions.availability_model: Bernoulli requests with logistic-normal artist and content random effects; the control request is shared, and the stress scenario permits refusal to correlate with the latent target artist effect
assumptions.clustering: crossed Gaussian artist, content-block, and persistent artist-by-content effects plus residual variation; planning detection root-sum-squares artist- and block-marginal SEs
assumptions.conditional_content_weighting_limitation: within an artist, usable content/repetition pairs are frequency-weighted; a final equal-content estimand and its aligned crossed-cluster estimator remain prospective TODOs
assumptions.conditional_point_estimator: equal mean of per-artist usable-pair means; within each artist, usable content-block/repetition pairs receive equal pair weight, so an artist's availability count does not determine its top-level weight
assumptions.control_structure: one artist-free control request is shared across artists within each content-block/repetition cell

minimum_valid_clusters_for_planning_even.artist_axis: all configured roster artists must have a usable pair

multiplicity.method: Bonferroni sensitivity threshold for two co-primary estimands
multiplicity.small_cluster_correction: candidate-specific Student-t critical-value approximation with df=min(artist_count, content_block_count)-1

assumptions.outcome_scale: each conditional A-vector-proximity outcome has unit total latent variance within a scenario; effect values are standardized assumptions

shared_control_covariance.structure: one block-by-repetition control residual is shared by every artist's paired contrast in that cell; the remaining residual is artist-specific

planning_test_proxy.final_analysis_method: not selected by this development simulation
planning_test_proxy.method: root-sum-squared crossed marginal-cluster SE with a third-order Cornish-Fisher Student-t critical-value approximation
